*   **Internal Elastic Lamina (IEL):** Normally, this appears as a distinct, wavy, dark-staining line separating the intima from the media. In this image, specifically in the area of the large atherosclerotic plaque, the IEL is either fragmented, severely thinned, or completely obliterated.
